details:
Description

previously, i could set bindings in the control menu with hand tracking to turn off certian functions such as menu spawning with index, so I could setup custom commands using the steam vr input binding system. However, the menu no longer has that ability, making hand tracking usage frustrating. Also, the buttons to switch between real world / avatar hand tracking no longer work, and only stay on avatar hand tracking. Im guessing this broke during an update and was left unchecked?

Reproduction Steps

Activate hand tracking, and attempt to change any setting within settings/control/hand tracking. the menu does now respond as intended / is missing previous functions

Details

- Category: User Interface

- Frequency: Always
